text:
alex: Heads up — need break-glass access to customer_db for a suspected PII exposure investigation. Requesting temporary admin read-only for 2 hours. TL;DR: investigate query spike, do NOT write.

sam: pinging @harry and @security-bot for approval. Can someone confirm scope and auditing requirements? :lock:

priya: What tables/columns do you need? Also define exact time window and whether we need any export.

alex: scope: db=customer_db, tables: orders, customers, activity_logs. columns: id, name, email, phone, order_id, timestamp. timeframe: last 48h. No exports except scrubbed screenshots for the incident ticket.

maria: If approved, ops will create an ephemeral role and restrict to read-only via `assume-role --duration 2h`. We'll rotate creds after. Will also enable session recording.

deploy-bot: Access request created: BRK-4319. Assigned to: harry. Audit token: at_77e2.

harry: Please include a short justification for the ticket body, and paste the exact SQL(s) you'll run. Approving only if we have session capture + redaction plan.

alex: Justification: investigating unusual export-like activity from app-service that may have exposed emails. SQL snippets: ```sql
SELECT id, email, order_id, timestamp FROM customers JOIN orders USING(id) WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '48 hours';
```

priya: Redaction plan: no raw exports. Any results for sharing must run through the redaction script below before leaving the VM. Keep everything in the secured investigation project.

```bash
# run locally on the results file before sharing
./tools/redact_pii.py --input results.json --fields email,phone --mask --out results_redacted.json
```

alex: Confirmed — will run on a jumpbox with no external network egress and use `results_redacted.json` for any screenshots. No S3 uploads.

harry: Approved for 2 hours starting now (BRK-4319). Conditions: session recording enabled, logs forwarded to audit-retention for 90 days, just-in-time role revoked at expiry, and any artifacts must be redacted per priya's script. I'll add a Slack audit note when I flip the switch. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Approval recorded: BRK-4319 approved by harry. session_id=ses_88c4. Audit link: https://audit.example.com/BRK-4319

maria: Created ephemeral role `breakglass/brk-4319` — run `assume-role breakglass/brk-4319` and confirm session id matches `ses_88c4`. Ops will monitor.

sam: tagging incident channel #inc-574 so incident lead sees this. alex pls paste the queries you run into the ticket as well.

alex: Will do. Starting now on jumpbox. I'll DM any immediate findings. Thanks all. :pray:

priya: Quick note — if you need to copy rows, use the SELECT INTO temp table pattern and keep it in the DB only. No CSV exports.

alex: noted. ending session and will provide summary in BRK-4319 when done.

maria: closing operational loop — keys will rotate at `1779008510`. Remember to request another BRK if follow-up needed.

sam: good runthrough, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
